params.prompt:
Create one continuous eight-second luxury campaign hero shot. The supplied still is the sole authority for this collection's scene, composition, lettering, monuments, shapes and colors. Use the supplied Signature video ONLY as a reference for restrained, physically coherent motion and photographic finish; do not import its location, gold palette, lettering or monogram. Keep the camera locked, the exact viewpoint and focal length fixed, and both the opening and closing composition aligned to the still. No cuts or camera zoom. Favor a clean continuous loop with matching lighting and motion at the seam. Animate the real atmosphere of the black Gothic cathedral. Existing distant candle flames flicker irregularly, with corresponding small warm shifts in the nearby stone, glass and wet-floor reflections; avoid synchronized pulsing. A very sparse amount of fine dust drifts slowly through the central light shaft with natural depth, occlusion and soft focus. Subtle low air haze moves along the distant aisle, not over the foreground monuments. Keep the enchanted rose inside its glass bell jar essentially still and anatomically unchanged; highlights on the glass respond naturally to the nearby candlelight. Preserve the thorn-covered arches, crimson illuminated windows, glossy red Love Hurts script, rose/star/broken-heart monument and the original back-facing cloaked silhouette without body or facial changes. The silhouette remains motionless. Reflections retain their actual geometry and lighting sources. Preserve rich blacks, deep crimson and the small warm sanctuary light. The shot should feel like a patiently observed cinematic set with moving air and practical candles, not a still decorated with digital particles.

Avoid: No falling-petal overlay, petal shower, glitter, snow, ember storm, rain indoors, floating logos, luminous dust sprites, breathing letters, flexing thorns, growing or opening rose, wind inside sealed glass, moving statue, walking figure, revealed face, extra people, flickering red neon, synchronized glow pulses, frame-wide brightness pumping, blanket fog, camera zoom, altered words, new symbols, soundtrack or Signature imagery.

review_requirements: Compare the complete candidate against the supplied hero source and the Signature motion benchmark.
Reject lettering, monument, bridge, rose, figure, or architecture deformation.
Judge material motion, lighting coherence, occlusion, spatial depth, and first/last-frame loop continuity.
Reject generic screen-space effects, conspicuous ripple rings, petal showers, and frame-wide brightness pulses.
Retain the original still and current runtime assets until replacement review and wiring authorization.
